text:
deploy-bot: DEPL-2219 requesting expedited hotfix deploy for service `route-svc`
Reason: intermittent crash on missing X-Route header observed in prod (~1% of requests in eu-west).
Proposed image: `route-svc:1.4.8` (patch adds null-check).
Change window: immediate — canary 5% for 15m then roll to 100% if healthy.
Rollback image pinned: `route-svc:1.4.7`.
Release notes draft: https://scm/repo/route/compare/1.4.7...1.4.8
Requesting approvals: @Priya @Alex @Mei @Taylor
---
Alex: Ack. Can you share blast radius and which customers are impacted?

Priya: Repro confirmed from traces. Impacted path: /v1/route when header missing. ~1% of total requests in eu-west1, 0.02% elsewhere. Patch is one-line guard. Blast radius limited but crashes are user-facing 500s. Recommend canary + strict health probes.

Mei: Oncall — I can own rollout. We need SRE + Product signoff before go. Jordan FYI for comms.

Jordan: FYI — I'll prep a short customer-facing blurb if we push. Prefer to avoid visible errors but if needed we'll post a status update.

Taylor: SRE check: +1 for expedited deploy if we keep canary at 5% and readinessProbe timeout set to 10s. Will monitor error budget and p50/p95 latency. Need rollback runbook on-hand.

Priya: Release notes line: "Fix crash when X-Route header is missing in routing path." Tagging build `1.4.8-hotfix-null-header`. Changelog PR: https://scm/repo/route/pull/478

Alex: +1 from product. :thumbsup:

Mei: +1 from oncall. Setting canary to 5% for 15m. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% absolute or 5x spike vs baseline in any region -> immediate rollback.

Taylor: I'm ready to trigger. @deploy-bot can you start the canary?

deploy-bot: Starting canary now.
```
# deploy command
/deploy start --service route-svc --image route-svc:1.4.8 --region eu-west1 --traffic 5% --canary 15m --health-check readiness=10s
```
Rollback command (manual):
```
/deploy rollback --service route-svc --image route-svc:1.4.7 --region eu-west1
```
Monitoring links: https://dash.company/route-svc, logs: https://logs.company/route
---
Alex: Watching dashboards. latency ok so far.

Mei: 7m into canary — error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.01). Keep watching.

Taylor: 12m update — error rate jumped to 0.6% in eu-west on 1.4.8 (crossed 0.5% threshold). Recommending rollback.

Priya: I see the spike in traces — an edge case with proxied requests missing header + specific upstream timing. Agree rollback. Rolling back now.

deploy-bot: Rollback initiated — reverting to `route-svc:1.4.7` in eu-west1. Estimated completion ~2m.

Alex: Noted. Opening postmortem stub and adding links to PR and logs.

Jordan: Pausing customer message. Will draft an update explaining attempted hotfix and rollback; will avoid technical details until postmortem.

Mei: Tagging this as "hotfix attempt failed — follow-up required". Assigning Priya as owner for follow-up patch and tests.

Priya: I'll prepare `1.4.9` with expanded checks and more unit/integration tests covering the proxied header path. Expect draft PR in ~2h and will request a safer canary (2% then 10%).

Taylor: Thanks all. Please add explicit rollback criteria into release notes and runbook so next push is faster. Closing this deploy thread once PR is up. :white_check_mark:
